tools.name: ons_search
tools.description: Search ONS datasets, bulletins and time series. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: ons_timeseries
tools.description: Observations for an ONS time series by CDID, e.g. D7G7 CPIH annual rate, L55O CPIH index, MGSX unemployment rate, ABMI GDP. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: boe_series
tools.description: Bank of England database series: Bank Rate (IUDBEDR, default), exchange rates (XUDLUSS), quoted mortgage rates (IUMBV34) and more. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: fca_search
tools.description: Check whether a firm or person is authorised by the FCA (UK Financial Services Register): status, firm reference number (FRN), and warnings for clones and unauthorised businesses. Use before paying or dealing with a financial firm, adviser, lender or broker. (cost: 1 credit)

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "fca_search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search the FCA Financial Services Register for authorised firms or individuals. (cost: 1 credit)" → after: "Check whether a firm or person is authorised by the FCA (UK Financial Services Register): status, firm reference number (FRN), and warnings for clones and unauthorised businesses. Use before paying or dealing with a financial firm, adviser, lender or broker. (cost: 1 credit)"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
